description: Format messy SQL: keywords uppercased, clauses on new lines, and subqueries indented properly.

faqs.a: Yes — single-quoted, double-quoted, and backtick strings plus -- and /* */ comments are preserved untouched.
SELECT, FROM, WHERE, JOINs, ON, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, HAVING, LIMIT, UNION, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and more.
faqs.q: Which clauses get their own line?

faqs.a: Subqueries in parentheses are indented one extra level automatically.
It is a formatter, not a validator — it will not catch SQL syntax errors.

title: SQL Formatter
